caption: Castello Odescalchi, Bracciano
composition: Medieval lakeside castle with round towers above Lake Bracciano · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The cobbled approach road curves in from the lower right toward the castle gate, with the great square keep and round towers massed at the center against a bright blue sky. Lake Bracciano spreads out at the left, the town's rooftops edging the shore below, and dry-stone walls line the path. At 11:31 the sun is high, and the grey stone glows warm in the midday light.
